pages.title: Auth API v1 Removal Readiness Review
pages.content:
# Removal readiness

The Auth API v1 removal is approved for 2026-10-01. The review records that all known consumers completed migration to Auth API v2. MCP Gateway and Argo Orchestrator now consume POST /v2/auth and no longer call POST /v1/auth.

Based on this review, Auth Service may delete the v1 production route.
